text.title: 没有点头的顾客
text.situation:
伊莱周二回来，站在柜台另一边，面对杰伊。新提手很牢固，但一小块内衬被缝进了一条接缝。他是来投诉，不是提出新的维修要求。伊莱不太放心再把包留下，倾向于拿到别处。杰伊起初的语气有些轻视：“只是一点点内衬。”他一边说，一边已经去拿下一张卡。他本想让伊莱放心，回答却产生相反效果。伊莱反对为不是自己造成的错误付费。米娜从后门口听到对话，先把下一张卡放到一旁，请伊莱指出内衬拉扯的位置。这次杰伊没有再伸手去处理队伍里的其他单子。

伊莱：我要投诉这次维修，内衬在这里被缝住了。
杰伊：现在我看到了。
伊莱：再留下包，我有顾虑，而且我反对为第二次维修付费。
米娜：先让我们检查接缝。你决定之前，我们会说明能纠正什么。

paragraphs.en: Eli returned on Tuesday and stood opposite Jay at the counter. The new handle was strong, but the lining had been caught in one seam. He had a complaint, not a new repair request. Eli had reservations about leaving the bag again; he was inclined to take it elsewhere. Jay first sounded dismissive. “It is only a tiny bit of lining,” he said, already reaching for the next card. He meant to reassure Eli, but his answer had the opposite effect. Eli was opposed to paying for a mistake he had not caused. Mina heard the conversation from the rear doorway. She put the next card aside and asked Eli to show her where the lining pulled. This time Jay kept his hand away from the queue.

paragraphs.en:
Eli: I have a complaint about the repair. The lining is caught here.
Jay: I see it now.
Eli: I have reservations about leaving it again. And I am opposed to paying for a second repair.
Mina: Let us examine the seam first. We will tell you what we can put right before you decide.

S08.Q08.P01.function: The customer who did not nod
S08.Q08.P01.cue: 说说伊莱的投诉、顾虑和在柜台的位置。
acceptableAnswers: 伊莱要投诉这次维修。 伊莱对再次留下包有顾虑。 伊莱站在柜台另一边，面对杰伊。

S08.Q08.P02.function: The customer who did not nod
S08.Q08.P02.cue: 说说伊莱的顾虑和打算。
acceptableAnswers: 伊莱反对为第二次维修付费。 伊莱倾向于把包拿到别处。

S08.Q08.P03.function: The customer who did not nod
S08.Q08.P03.cue: 说明杰伊的回答为什么让事情更糟。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊最初的回答显得轻视问题。 杰伊的回答产生了相反效果。

S08.Q08.T01.function: The customer who did not nod
S08.Q08.T01.cue: 你不确定一个计划是否行得通，怎样礼貌表达顾虑？
acceptableAnswers: 我对这个计划有些顾虑。
